purpose: Record Derek’s in-hand fit assessment of the printed east rear rail coupon pair.
fit_result: Good enough on the paired coupons. The upper coupon flexes away at the negative-Y end under hand pressure.
request: Extend the rib to the negative-Y mating face so its end is flush with that face.
quote: The fit is pretty good, or at least good enough. As you can see in the photos there, though, what I did is I pushed it a bit, and I can still bend the top half a bit away, as you can see in that photo on the negative Y most side there. I don't think I want to do too much about that, but I would like at least, or only, I would like the rib to extend further in the negative Y direction so it's flush with that negative Y face, the same as everything else there, as opposed to being recessed into the cave as it is right now, as you can see in one of my photos. So please make and implement that change. Thanks.
